use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Random

use Move = (from: int, to: int)

let random = Random(8)
let start = "BBB...WWW"

other(side: char) -> char => if side == 'W' then 'B' else 'W' fi

moves(board: string, side: char) -> List[Move] =>
    (0..9)
        |> filter(from => board[from] == side)
        |> flat_map(from =>
            let ahead = from + if side == 'W' then -3 else 3 fi in
            [ahead - 1, ahead, ahead + 1]
                |> filter(to =>
                    to >= 0 /\ to < 9 /\ to / 3 == ahead / 3 /\
                    if to == ahead then board[to] == '.'
                    else board[to] == other(side)
                    fi)
                |> map(to => (from = from, to = to)))
        |> collect_list()

play(board: string, move: Move) -> string =>
    string(
        (0..9)
            |> map(i =>
                if i == move.to then board[move.from]
                elif i == move.from then '.'
                else board[i]
                fi)
            |> collect_array())

has_won(board: string, side: char) -> bool =>
    let far_rank = if side == 'W' then 0 else 6 fi in
    board.substring(far_rank, 3).contains(side) \/
    moves(board, other(side)).count == 0

square(index: int) -> string => "{"abc"[index % 3]}{3 - index / 3}"

show(board: string) is
    for row in 0..3 do
        write_line("{3 - row} {board.substring(row * 3, 3)}")
    od

    write_line("  abc")
si

parse(text: string) -> Move? is
    let squares = text.replace(" ", "").replace("-", "")

    if squares.length != 4 then
        return null
    fi

    let index = (at: int) =>
        (3 - (cast int(squares[at + 1]) - cast int('0'))) * 3 +
        cast int(squares[at]) - cast int('a')

    (from = index(0), to = index(2))
si

let memory = MAP[string, LIST[Move]]()

options(board: string) -> LIST[Move] is
    if !memory.contains_key(board) then
        memory[board] = LIST[Move](moves(board, 'B'))
    fi

    memory[board]
si

game(white: (string) -> Move?, verbose: bool) -> char is
    let board mut = start
    let last_board mut = ""
    let last_move mut = (from = 0, to = 0)

    let forget_last_move = () is
        if last_board.length > 0 then
            memory[last_board].remove(last_move)
        fi
    si

    while true do
        if verbose then
            show(board)
        fi

        let move = white(board)

        if !move? then
            return '?'
        fi

        board = play(board, move)

        if has_won(board, 'W') then
            forget_last_move()
            return 'W'
        fi

        let choices = options(board)

        if choices.count == 0 then
            if verbose then
                write_line("the computer resigns")
            fi

            forget_last_move()
            return 'W'
        fi

        let chosen = choices[random.next(choices.count)]
        last_board = board
        last_move = chosen

        if verbose then
            let (from, to) = (square(chosen.from), square(chosen.to))
            write_line("the computer plays {from}-{to}")
        fi

        board = play(board, chosen)

        if has_won(board, 'B') then
            if verbose then
                show(board)
            fi

            return 'B'
        fi
    od

    '?'
si

human(board: string) -> Move? is
    let legal = moves(board, 'W')

    while true do
        write_line("your move (for example a1-a2)?")

        let line = read_line()

        if !line? then
            return null
        fi

        write_line("> {line}")

        if let move = parse(line) /\ legal |> any(m => m =~ move) then
            return move
        fi

        write_line("that is not a legal move")
    od

    null
si

trainer(board: string) -> Move? =>
    let legal = moves(board, 'W') in
    legal[random.next(legal.count)]

for number in 1::3 do
    write_line("game {number}")

    case game(human, true)
    when 'W' then write_line("you win")
    when 'B' then write_line("the computer wins")
    else break
    esac

    write_line()
od

write_line("the computer now trains against random play:")

for round in 1::5 do
    let wins =
        (0..20) |> filter(_ => game(trainer, false) == 'B') |> count()

    write_line(
        "  games {round * 20 - 19} to {round * 20}: "
        "the computer wins {wins}")
od
